title: 한국도로공사법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (117) Omitted.
(118) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Korea Expressway Corporation Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (2) and the attached form, "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport."
(119) through (126) Omitted.
